description: The line plot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny,” illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) performance across six training epochs for five different quantization variants of the Whisper tiny model. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch, indicating discrete training steps. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” spans from 20 to 70, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 10, representing the error rate percentage. Five distinct lines are plotted: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” (solid gray line with circle markers) starts at ~69 WER and declines steadily to ~40; “tiny” (solid gray line with square markers) begins at ~60 and drops to ~32; “tiny int4” (dashed gray line with circle markers) starts at ~60 and falls to ~38; “tiny int8” (dashed gray line with square markers) begins at ~47 and decreases to ~36; and “tiny full” (dotted gray line with triangle markers) starts at ~29, dips slightly to ~24 by epoch 3, then stabilizes near ~23 by epoch 6. All lines show a general downward trend in WER over epochs, with “tiny full” consistently achieving the lowest error rate throughout training.
